description: Add an extra layer of safety to your toddler's bed with this 3/4 guard rail. Designed to fit crib conversions across all Heirloom Collections, this guard rail provides secure protection while your child transitions to a bed. Solid hardwood construction with BrownMaple finish. Easy to attach and remove.
